notes.title: Demo Patch #1
notes.content:
We received some awesome feedback and will be actioning as much as possible before release, below is a small chunk of that.

[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]Added:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Distortion effect.
[*]Basic onboarding for play menu.
[*]A more jiving interface SFX.
[*]Health bars on enemies.
[*]Version number to top of screen.
[/list]
[h3]Fixed:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Asteroid from spawning to close to planet.
[/list]
